response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced senior/staff engineer with strong systems programming background (D language, C/C++ at National Instruments, low-latency async I/O work at Sociomantic) and even relevant geospatial GIS experience via GISCollective and Green Map, but his recent and predominant career trajectory has shifted decisively toward web/full-stack development (TypeScript, Node.js, React) with no C++ or Rust work in nearly a decade and no evidence of distributed-system routing pipeline or navigation guidance production experience, making him a weak match for a role requiring modern C++/Rust as the primary technology.
strengths: Deep polyglot systems background including C/C++ and D with async I/O, fibers, and high-performance database experience
Directly relevant domain exposure through GIS/geospatial platform work (GISCollective, Green Map)
Strong track record of technical leadership, mentoring, and CI/CD/testing discipline across senior and staff roles
concerns: No modern C++ or Rust experience in the last ~10 years; recent roles are almost entirely TypeScript/Node.js/web stack
No demonstrated experience with routing tiles, navigation guidance QA, or real-time traffic data pipelines
Limited recent exposure to distributed-system reliability/fault-tolerance concepts at the scale implied by the role
